summary: Build skills taxonomy, HRIS integration, governance, staffing, and learning pathway capability. Develop an enterprise rollout plan with TrainingCred.
lede: Skills-based organisation training helps HR, organisational design, learning and transformation leaders use governed skills data in workforce decisions. Participants practise shaping a skills taxonomy, setting ownership and data-quality controls, and matching workforce capability to project demand. Exercises also cover HRIS integration, learning pathways and adoption planning, producing practical artefacts for an implementation roadmap that can be validated against their organisation’s systems and workforce data.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for leaders and specialists who must translate skills-based organisation strategy into governed workforce, HR technology, staffing, and learning decisions.
audience: Project Portfolio Managers using skills profiles
prerequisites: Prior experience in HR strategy, organisational design, workforce planning, learning and development, HR technology, or transformation leadership is recommended. You should understand basic HR operating models and workforce terminology. No coding or programming is required. Advanced technology topics receive operational application treatment, including workflow design, data governance, and tool commissioning rather than technical engineering or production software deployment.
